name: Invisible Quantum State
hint: If there are no waiting blocks between the superposition or entanglement start and the measurement, you cannot see the quantum state.
instruction: Add a wait block between the superposition or entanglement start and the measurement.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
entangle variable: [color v] target: [Cat] possibilities: (1) list: [list] :: #5c068c
measure :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
entangle variable: [color v] target: [Cat] possibilities: (1) list: [list] :: #5c068c
wait (3) seconds
measure :: #007000 //⇦  👍
